extensionDescription.message: Sort messages into Important, Newsletters, and Social. Connect ChatGPT, OpenRouter, Gemini, or Grok to summarize a thread or draft a reply.

optionsLead.message: Rules on this computer sort the obvious messages. The model is used when you ask for it, or when a message is hard to sort.

optionModelHelp.message: Leave this blank to use the provider’s default model.

optionAutoHelp.message: Tag messages as they arrive in the inbox.

optionAiTitle.message: Ask the model when rules are unsure

optionAiHelp.message: Sends the sender, the subject, and the beginning of the message. At most 40 messages an hour.

privacyNote.message: Rules run on this computer. The API key stays in this profile. The subject and a short excerpt are sent to the selected provider only when the model is called.

popupLead.message: If more than one message is selected, those messages are sorted. Otherwise the current page of this folder is sorted, up to 50 messages. Tags appear in the message list and in the quick filter.

composeLead.message: Replies and summaries are written in English.

presetShorterInstruction.message: Make the current draft shorter and keep its meaning.

presetDeclineInstruction.message: Politely decline. Be brief and courteous.

defaultReplyInstruction.message: Write a helpful reply to the latest message.

defaultComposeInstruction.message: Write a reply based on the quoted message and this draft.

cappedNote.message: $COUNT$ were not sorted because the hourly limit was reached.

errorMissingKey.message: Add an API key for the selected provider.

errorNoJson.message: The model did not return JSON.

errorUnknownCategory.message: The model did not return a category.

errorSummaryEmpty.message: This thread has no text to summarize.

errorEmpty.message: The provider returned an empty answer.
